description: Grafana v2 example for vault-solver metrics. Uses example scrape labels namespace and pod; adapt selectors, grouping and table fields to your collection setup. Choose a Prometheus-compatible datasource. Counters cover the selected interval; current state uses current samples. Missing data is not a healthy state.

spec.title: Decision counts
spec.description: Quoted and bounded decline reasons over the selected range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Quote latency
spec.description: End-to-end quote-handler latency distribution over time. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Quoted token amounts
spec.description: Input/output atomic units remain separated by token and side. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Order poll counts
spec.description: Exclusive and public poll continuity by result. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Delivery pressure
spec.description: Current admitted work, nearest exclusivity deadline, and breaker cooldown. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod) (clamp_min((uniswapx_exclusive_nearest_deadline_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}) - time(), 0) * ((uniswapx_exclusive_nearest_deadline_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}) > bool time()))

max by (namespace, pod) (clamp_min((uniswapx_block_until_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}) - time(), 0) * ((uniswapx_block_until_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}) > bool time()))

spec.title: Activity ages
spec.description: Comparable freshness/activity ages without deployment-specific alarm thresholds. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Delivery outcomes
spec.description: Exact met/missed exclusive-delivery terminal counts. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Successful fill amounts
spec.description: Receipt-confirmed token amounts; planned surplus is not realized PnL. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Fill transaction outcomes
spec.description: Exact terminal txmanager outcomes over the selected range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.title: Execution cost
spec.description: Receipt-backed transaction count, gas, and native fee over the selected range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: ((sum(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="uniswapx-filler",event="quote",outcome="quoted"}[$__range]))) / sum(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="uniswapx-filler",event="quote"}[$__range])))) >= 0) or ((sum(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="uniswapx-filler",event="quote"}[$__range]))) == 0) - 1)

spec.title: Pod details
spec.description: Per-pod values. Counters cover the selected interval; readiness and gauges use current samples. Retired pods have no current state.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod) (min by (namespace, pod, strategy) (uniswapx_ready{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

max by (namespace, pod) (sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="uniswapx-filler",event="quote",outcome="quoted"}[$__range])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_events_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",solver="uniswapx-filler",event="quote"}[$__range])))

title: Vault Solver · UniswapX

spec.name: pods
spec.label: Pods
spec.description: All expands to the pod names discovered for this solver and selected time range.
